lines.zh: 一脚深，一脚浅，我拖着走。
lines.en: One foot deep, one shallow, I drag along.
The swamp mud sucks at my feet.
I raise an arm and reach forward.
Foul water runs off me.
Slow, but I do not rest.

lines.zh: 红树林的根绊了我一下。
lines.en: A mangrove root trips me.
I lean and go around it.
Bubbles pop one by one underfoot.
I groan as I walk.
In the shade I look like rotten wood.
I have stepped into deeper mud.
Forward. Always forward.
I stand with water at my knees.
Something rattles in my throat.
I stare one way for a long time.
Little insects crawl on me.
Mud and water are all my smell.
I twisted my neck slowly.
This swamp is not new to me.
My fingers stay curled.
My head is empty.
Weeds wrap around my ankle.
An insect crosses my face.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖在泥里往下陷。
lines.en: My knees sink deeper into the mud.

lines.zh: 腐烂的味道，我自己闻不到。
lines.en: I cannot smell my own rot.
I raise a hand and look at it.
Fog creeps in from the roots of the trees.
I lower my arm.
The wind comes from behind me.
The bones creak under my skin.
A living one. I smell it.
My eyes stick to you.

lines.zh: 你走开的时候，我还在看。
lines.en: When you walk off, I'm still watching.
I point a finger at you.
Will you walk this path too?
Do not run; I do not walk fast.
I look at you with my head tilted.
Your smell is fresh.
The swamp takes everyone.
Something gurgles in my throat.
You stepped back. I noticed.
Come here. Closer.
I sway, still on my feet.

lines.zh: 这一下只让我歪得更多。
lines.en: That only made me lean further.
A piece of flesh came off.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里发出一声闷响。
lines.en: A dull sound comes from my throat.
I drag my legs forward.
Your cut did not go deep.
Muddy water seeps into the wound.
This body was ruined long ago.
My shoulder has come loose.
Slow down. I am still moving.
Rotten flesh? Bring it here.
I know that smell.
Hand it over. Do not be afraid.
I have been hungry in this swamp a long while.
I can chew this one.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，泥也盖不住。
lines.en: The smell of rotten meat gets through the mud.
Feed me, and I will follow.
My fingers close around your elbow.
I open my mouth and wait for you to let go.
This taste wakes me a little.
I bump you open with a shoulder.
We collide against a root.
The shove puts your feet in the mud.
My own body went crooked.
Rotting flesh lands with a soft thud.
I do not stop. I keep going.
We both got splashed.
Do not block my way.
That should have moved you aside.
I find my footing in the mud again.
There are others in this swamp.
We do not look at each other.
We walk in a single line through the muck.
You are half rotted too.
Water drips off both of us.
We stir more at night.
This waterway leads deeper in.
Neither of us needs to speak.
Same smell, same slow pace.
Another day, another step.
I bend and pick it up.
I grip it and do not let go.
This can be thrown.
Even what fell in the mud, I take.
One bite, and there is no taste.
It is soaked, but it will do.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进破烂的衣兜。
lines.en: I stuff it into a ragged pocket.

lines.zh: 我捡起来的，准备扔出去。
lines.en: I picked it up to throw it.

lines.zh: 我把它在衣服上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I rub it across my rags.
I will bring it back to the others.
This one is alive.
I saw you move, so I came.
Muddy water drips from my arms.
The target is right ahead.
My steps quickened a little.
Do not hide in the shadows.
My steps startle the insects up.
The swamp will keep your footprints.
My hand has come up.
Time to move.
I shuffle toward you step by step.
Not fast, but endless.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在泥里很清楚。
lines.en: Your footprints stand out in the mud.
The water does not hide my steps.
I go around that tree.
I stare at the puddle you stepped in.
You are by the water. I see you.
One step, then two.
Do not waste your strength running.
The swamp will slow you down.
I swing a hand at you.
There is no skill in that blow.
My fingers caught you.
I open my mouth and bite.
Mud smears onto you as well.
I stagger back and lunge again.
Slow, but heavy.
I swing my hand onto your back.
My teeth are poor; the bite is shallow.
I am still coming forward.
I come out of the swamp mist.
Bubbles break on the water.
A figure rises out of the mud.

lines.zh: 红树林里，多了一个影子。
lines.en: Another shadow in the mangroves.
I drag my feet onto the bank.
I am covered in silt.
The swamp pushed me up.
Waterweed hangs off my shoulder.
A green haze hugs the ground.
The swamp has one more resident.
I lift my rotting head.
The footsteps begin in the mud.
Fire scorches me quickly.
I crash into the mud and leave a pit.

lines.zh: 沼气从我的嘴里冒出去。
lines.en: Swamp gas bubbles out of my mouth.
The blast throws me into the water.

lines.zh: 一根东西插进我的皮肉。
lines.en: Something is stuck in my flesh.
This light tightens my flesh.
Too hungry to even walk.

lines.zh: 雷打在沼泽上，我抽了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the swamp and I jerk.

lines.zh: 我抓不住任何湿的东西。
lines.en: I can't grab hold of anything wet.
